insights.title: Immediate Income Available
insights.msg: ✅ Gig work and service-based hustles can generate income in 1-2 weeks. Perfect if you need cash flow quickly.

insights.title: Low Startup Cost Options
insights.msg: ✅ Many hustles require zero startup: freelance writing, social media management, tutoring, pet sitting. Start with no risk.

insights.title: High Earning Potential
insights.msg: ✅ Tech and consulting roles ($1,000–$10,000/month) offer the highest hourly rates and income ceilings.

insights.title: Passive Income Path
insights.msg: ✅ Blogging, online courses, YouTube, stock photography, and affiliate marketing offer true passive income after initial work.

insights.title: Strong Demand Growing
insights.msg: ✅ Your selection matches fields with 8–22% job growth (web dev, app dev, social media, delivery).

insights.title: Setup Time Investment
insights.msg: ℹ️ Passive income hustles (courses, blogs, YouTube) require 100+ hours upfront and 6–12 months before ROI.

insights.title: Ongoing Expenses Vary
insights.msg: ℹ️ Active hustles ($0–50/mo), e-commerce ($100–500/mo), and tech ($0–60/mo). Plan your operational costs.

insights.title: Market Saturation High
insights.msg: ℹ️ Writing, design, YouTube, blogging, and e-commerce are competitive. Differentiation and marketing are critical.

insights.title: Seasonal Fluctuations
insights.msg: ℹ️ Tutoring, photography, pet sitting, and e-commerce peak seasonally (holidays, back-to-school). Plan cash flow accordingly.

insights.title: High Competition
insights.msg: ⚠️ Blogging, dropshipping, affiliate marketing, and freelance writing have many competitors. Expect slow initial growth.

insights.title: Significant Learning Curve
insights.msg: ⚠️ App/web development and video production require months of learning before profitability. Not fast-money options.

insights.title: Time-Intensive Setup
insights.msg: ⚠️ YouTube (12+ months), blogging (6+ months), and online courses (3–6 months) have long ramps before meaningful income.

insights.title: Active vs Passive Mismatch
insights.msg: ⚠️ Gig work (delivery, tasking, pet sitting) requires active time every month with no leverage for income scaling.

insights.title: Passive Income + High Earning Conflict
insights.msg: 💥 True passive income (courses, stock photos, affiliate) conflicts with high hourly rates. Most passive options earn slowly.

insights.title: Low Startup + No Ongoing Cost Conflict
insights.msg: 💥 Hustles with zero startup often need ongoing platform fees ($29/mo Shopify, $55/mo Adobe). Review true costs.

insights.title: Immediate Income + Scalability Conflict
insights.msg: 💥 Gig work pays immediately but doesn't scale beyond your time. Online courses scale but take 6+ months to profit.
